title: Add IBuildGoal marker interface to replace type-checks
description:
## Problem
HtnPlanner and other pipeline code uses `goal is BuildGoal` type-checks to identify build goals. This is fragile — adding new goal types that behave like builds requires updating every type-check site.

## Solution
Add `IBuildGoal` marker interface in `Agent.Core/Interfaces/`. Have `BuildGoal` implement it. Replace all `goal is BuildGoal` type-checks with `goal is IBuildGoal`.

## Files
- Agent.Core/Interfaces/IGoal.cs (add IBuildGoal)
- Agent.Planning/BuildGoal.cs (implement IBuildGoal)
- Agent.Planning/HtnPlanner.cs (replace type-checks)
- Any other files using `is BuildGoal` pattern

## Validation
- All existing tests pass
- grep for `is BuildGoal` returns zero results (except the single implementation site)
